from.place: The resolution-section comparison: normalized Hom cocycles, their restriction, and their augmentation-preserving pullback transfer, below the Mayer-Vietoris comparison. Substep: open-to-open restriction of normalized comparisons.

title: Open to open restriction of canonical resolution comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, G an abelian sheaf on its small etale site, I an injective resolution of G, and c a resolution-section comparison normalized on Hom cocycles [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. For every pair of opens A contained in B, natural-number degree q, and class x in H^q(I(B)), applying c.openEquiv A q after homology of section restriction B to A equals openCohomologyRestriction (A ≤ B) G q applied after c.openEquiv B q. The restriction includes the canonical inverse-image composition transport [lem-weil-pbc-open-cohomology-whole-restriction-naturality].

proof.text: Choose a cycle representative z for x using surjectivity of homologyπ. Apply homologyπ naturality to rewrite the homology map of x as the homology class of cyclesMap z, then apply the cocycle-level canonical open-to-open restriction theorem.

lean.statement: theorem resolutionSection_canonical_open_to_open {X : Scheme.{u}} (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (I : InjectiveResolution G) (c : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I) : ∀ (A B : X.Opens) (h : A ≤ B) q x, c.openEquiv A q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (etaleSectionMap (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (X.homOfLE h) (X.homOfLE_ι _) : Scheme.Etale.mk A.ι ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk B.ι) I.cocomplex) q x) = openCohomologyRestriction h G q (c.openEquiv B q x)
